**Step:** [step-9](../README.md) — Does the mechanism class of the child's BUB1B alleles, checked against sources that share nothing (a structure atlas, mouse phenotypes, expression signatures, cell-line screens, the child's own pharmacogenome, phenotype-specific safety), support each drug direction — and which approved candidates survive all of them?
**Status:** refuted  |  **Confidence:** 0.15  |  **Revisions:** 2
**Gene:** BUB1B  |  **Path:** e1-atlas

## The claim

P4-18: predicted stability change (ddG) separates the published abundance-lowering MVA missense alleles of BUB1B from the function-impairing ones

**Prediction if true.** over the MVA missense alleles Suijkerbuijk 2010 (PMID 20516114) and the other verified papers classify by protein level, the ddG-based score ranks abundance-lowering above function-impairing with AUROC >= 0.8

**What would refute it.** AUROC <= 0.6, or fewer than 4 labelled alleles per class can be recovered from the literature (then the test has no power and is reported as such)
